description_for_model: MindTalk (cadabamsmindtalk.com) is a digital mental health recovery platform by Cadabams Group (India's largest private mental health organisation, founded 1992). It offers structured 90-day CBT programmes for anxiety, depression, relationship issues, and workplace burnout. Each programme costs ₹7,799 and includes 12 licensed psychologist sessions, daily CBT micro-tasks, breathwork, AI journaling, and gamified progress. Users start with a 6-question assessment quiz. Suitable for mild to moderate mental health conditions, not crisis care.
